spec.title: HashiStack / Fleet Overview
spec.description: Is gcloud-dc healthy right now? Alert state, control-plane quorum, certificate runway, capacity headroom and mesh error rate on one screen. Drill into the per-subsystem dashboards from here.

spec.title: Firing alerts
spec.description: Alerts from hashistack.rules.yml currently firing (Watchdog excluded). There is no Alertmanager: read the alert names in the table below.

spec.title: Pending alerts
spec.description: Rules whose expression is true but whose `for:` has not yet elapsed.

spec.title: Targets down
spec.description: Scrape targets Prometheus cannot reach (alert TargetDown after 5m).

spec.title: Vault sealed
spec.description: Vault servers reporting sealed (alert VaultSealed after 1m).

spec.title: Raft quorums unhealthy
spec.description: Consul, Nomad and Vault autopilot clusters reporting unhealthy.

spec.expr: (count(consul_autopilot_healthy == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(nomad_nomad_autopilot_healthy == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(vault_autopilot_healthy == 0) or vector(0))

spec.title: Failed systemd units
spec.description: Platform units (consul, nomad, vault, vault-agent@*, node_exporter, podman-image-gc) in state failed on any host (alert PlatformUnitFailed).

spec.title: Shortest agent TLS cert
spec.description: Seconds until the soonest Consul or Nomad agent certificate expires. vault-agent renews them; red below 4h is the alert threshold.

spec.title: Shortest CA
spec.description: Runway of the Connect root/signing CA and the agent CA. Red below 30 days.

spec.title: Shortest mesh leaf cert
spec.description: Seconds until the soonest inbound mTLS leaf certificate on any sidecar expires. Connect re-signs leaves with roughly 7-29h left; below 2h rotation has stalled.

spec.title: Envoy sidecars live
spec.description: Scraped sidecars reporting LIVE. Compare with the targets-by-job panel.

spec.title: Running allocations
spec.description: Allocations running across every Nomad client.

spec.title: Mesh 5xx ratio
spec.description: Share of inbound HTTP requests answered 5xx across every sidecar's public listener.

spec.title: Active alerts
spec.description: Every pending or firing alert. Watchdog always fires: it proves the rule engine runs.

spec.title: Target availability by job
spec.description: Fraction of each job's targets answering their last scrape.

spec.title: Host CPU busy
spec.description: Non-idle CPU per host (node_exporter).

spec.title: Host memory used
spec.description: 1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal per host.

spec.title: Root filesystem used
spec.description: Alert HostDiskFilling fires below 10% free (red line).

spec.title: Nomad CPU reserved
spec.description: Share of each client's schedulable CPU (MHz) reserved by allocations. Placement fails at 100%.

spec.title: Nomad memory reserved
spec.description: Share of each client's schedulable memory reserved by allocations (memory_max not counted).

spec.title: Nomad allocations by state
spec.description: Client-side allocation states plus failed/lost counts from the servers' job summaries.

spec.title: Mesh inbound HTTP by status class
spec.description: Requests reaching every sidecar's public listener, by response class.

spec.title: Health -- every tile should be green
